name: awesome-asgi
desc: A curated list of awesome ASGI servers, frameworks, apps, libraries, and other resources

resources.name: Asgineer
resources.desc: A really thin ASGI web framework, which includes support for long polling, SSE and websockets.

resources.name: BlackSheep
resources.desc: BlackSheep is an asynchronous web framework to build event based web applications with Python. It is inspired by Flask, ASP.NET Core, and the work by Yury Selivanov.

resources.name: Channels
resources.desc: Asynchronous support for Django, and the original driving force behind the ASGI project. Supports HTTP and WebSockets with Django integration, and any protocol with ASGI-native code.

resources.name: Django
resources.desc: The web framework for perfectionists with deadlines. Has native ASGI support since version 3.0.

resources.name: Falcon
resources.desc: The minimalist REST and app backend framework for Python, with a focus on reliability, correctness, and performance at scale. Native ASGI support since version 3.0.

resources.name: FastAPI
resources.desc: A modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python 3.6+ based on standard Python type hints. Powered by Starlette and Pydantic. Supports HTTP and WebSockets.

resources.name: FastHTML
resources.desc: Modern web applications in pure Python. Built on solid web foundations, not the latest fads. Powerful and expressive, fast and lightweight, compact code, easy to learn and use.

resources.name: Guillotina
resources.desc: Full-featured ASGI-compatible REST application framework, designed for high performance and horizontally scaling solutions.

resources.name: Litestar
resources.desc: A high-performance ASGI framework, which offers msgspec-based message parsing, Depdency-Injection, Authentication, OpenAPI docs, and more. Supports HTTP and Websockets. Supports asyncio and trio.

resources.name: Pyotr
resources.desc: A server framework, as well as a client library, for serving and consuming OpenAPI-based Web services. Based on Starlette and HTTPX.

resources.name: Quart
resources.desc: A Python ASGI web microframework whose API is a superset of the Flask API. Supports HTTP (incl. SSE and HTTP/2 server push) and WebSockets.

resources.name: Responder
resources.desc: A familiar HTTP Service Framework for Python, powered by Starlette.

resources.name: Sanic
resources.desc: Sanic is a Python 3.6+ web server and web framework that's written to go fast. It allows the usage of the async/await syntax added in Python 3.5, which makes your code non-blocking and speedy. Supports HTTP and WebSockets.

resources.name: Starlette
resources.desc: The little ASGI framework that shines. Starlette is also an ASGI toolkit -- its modular design and reusable components made it foundational in the ASGI ecosystem. Supports HTTP and WebSockets. Supports asyncio and trio.

resources.name: Tonberry
resources.desc: Tonberry is an ASGI framework that takes a class based approach to routing. Influenced by CherryPy but made compatible with asyncio and WebSockets.

resources.name: Tremolo
resources.desc: Zero dependency ASGI server and web framework for Python. Request and response limits, bandwidth throttling, resumable downloads, multipart form uploads / streaming downloads, worker reloading. Only 2,500 lines with a focus on minimalism and stability.

resources.name: asgi-auth-github
resources.desc: GitHub OAuth authentication for ASGI apps. Supports restricting to specific users or member of specific teams or organizations.

resources.name: SessionAuth
resources.desc: Authenticate using sessions and cookies. (Shipped with Piccolo API, and requires Piccolo ORM.)

resources.name: TokenAuth
resources.desc: Authenticate using tokens in request headers. (Shipped with Piccolo API, and requires Piccolo ORM.)

resources.name: ASGIWebDAV
resources.desc: An asynchronous WebDAV server implementation. Support multi-provider, multi-account and permission control.

resources.name: Datasette
resources.desc: A tool for exploring and publishing data, including ASGI-compatible components and plugins.

resources.name: Ariadne
resources.desc: A schema first Python library for implementing GraphQL servers.

resources.name: Strawberry
resources.desc: A code first Python library for implementing GraphQL servers, inspired by dataclasses.

resources.name: tartiflette-asgi
resources.desc: ASGI support for the Tartiflette GraphQL engine.

resources.name: Apitally
resources.desc: Simple, privacy-focused API monitoring, analytics and request logging for popular ASGI frameworks (including FastAPI, Django, Starlette, Litestar).

resources.name: asgi-correlation-id
resources.desc: Request/Correlation ID logging middleware

resources.name: New Relic ASGI
resources.desc: New Relic integration for ASGI applications. (Shipped with newrelic.)

resources.name: opentelemetry-python
resources.desc: ASGI middleware and helpers for collecting application metrics via the (currently alpha) OpenTelemetry standard. Supports HTTP and WebSocket.

resources.name: Scout APM Starlette
resources.desc: Scout APM integration with Starlette and Starlette-based frameworks. (Shipped with scout-apm.)

resources.name: Sentry ASGI
resources.desc: Sentry integration for ASGI frameworks. (Shipped with sentry-sdk.)

resources.name: timing-asgi
resources.desc: ASGI middleware to record and emit timing metrics.

resources.name: asgi-proxy-lib
resources.desc: An ASGI function for proxying to a backend over HTTP.

resources.name: asgiproxy
resources.desc: Tools for building HTTP and Websocket proxies for ASGI.

resources.name: ProxyHeadersMiddleware
resources.desc: Use X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-For headers set by a known and trusted proxy to make client and scheme reference the connecting client (shipped with Uvicorn).

resources.name: python-socketio
resources.desc: WebSocket clients and servers using Socket.IO. Includes an ASGI application wrapper.

resources.name: asgi-htmx
resources.desc: HTMX integration for ASGI applications.

resources.name: ASGI Documentation
resources.desc: Documentation site for the ASGI specification.

resources.name: asgiref
resources.desc: ASGI reference implementation, including function wrappers, server base classes, type hints, and a WSGI-to-ASGI adapter.

resources.name: asgi-background
resources.desc: Background tasks for any ASGI framework.

resources.name: asgi-lifespan-middleware
resources.desc: ASGI middlewate to support ASGI lifespans using a simple async context manager interface.

resources.name: asgi-routing
resources.desc: A high performance router written in Rust for the ASGI ecosystem. Built on top of routrie and path-tree.

resources.name: nanoasgi
resources.desc: A tiny zero-dependency ASGI web framework.

resources.name: proxyx
resources.desc: Proof of concept for a lightweight HTTP/1.1 proxy service built with ASGI and HTTPX.

resources.name: py-frameworks-bench
resources.desc: A benchmark for (mostly-ASGI) Python async frameworks.

resources.name: asgi-csrf
resources.desc: ASGI middleware for protecting against CSRF attacks.

resources.name: asgi-ratelimit
resources.desc: A customizable rate limiting ASGI middleware, with regex path matching support.

resources.name: CORSMiddleware
resources.desc: Allow cross-origin requests from browsers. (Shipped with Starlette.)

resources.name: CSPMiddleware
resources.desc: Tell browsers to only run Javascript from the same origin. (Shipped with Piccolo API.)

resources.name: CSRFMiddleware
resources.desc: Protect against CSRF attacks when using cookies for authentication. (Shipped with Piccolo API.)

resources.name: HTTPSRedirectMiddleware
resources.desc: Redirect HTTP/WS traffic to HTTPS/WSS. (Shipped with Starlette.)

resources.name: RateLimitingMiddleware
resources.desc: Protect sensitive endpoints from brute force attacks. (Shipped with Piccolo API.)

resources.name: TrustedHostMiddleware
resources.desc: Guard against host header attacks by validating the Host header of requests. (Shipped with Starlette.)

resources.name: brotli-asgi
resources.desc: Response content compression using Brotli.

resources.name: GZipMiddleware
resources.desc: Response content compression using GZip. (Shipped with Starlette.)

resources.name: msgpack-asgi
resources.desc: Drop-in MessagePack support for ASGI apps and frameworks.

resources.name: Mangum
resources.desc: AWS Lambda & API Gateway support for ASGI.

resources.name: Daphne
resources.desc: An HTTP, HTTP2 and WebSocket protocol server for ASGI, developed to power Django Channels.

resources.name: Granian
resources.desc: A high performance Rust HTTP server for Python applications supporting ASGI/3 ASGI/3, RSGI and WSGI interfaces. Currenlty implementing HTTP 1 and 2 (eventually 3), HTTPS and websockets.

resources.name: Hypercorn
resources.desc: An ASGI server based on the sans-io hyper, h11, h2, and wsproto libraries. Supports HTTP/1, HTTP/2, WebSockets, ASGI 2.0 and ASGI 3.0. Compatible with asyncio, uvloop and trio worker types.

resources.name: Uvicorn
resources.desc: A fast ASGI server based on uvloop and httptools. Supports HTTP/1 and WebSockets.

resources.name: asgi-lifespan
resources.desc: Programmatic startup/shutdown of ASGI apps. Allows testing an ASGI app without having to spin up a server.

resources.name: async-asgi-testclient
resources.desc: A framework-agnostic library for testing ASGI web applications.

resources.name: HTTPX
resources.desc: Next generation HTTP client, including async support and ability to call ASGI apps directly.
